news-global-econ.title: Trump-Endorsed Harriet Hageman Wins Wyoming Republican Senate Primary
news-global-econ.description:
Rep. Harriet Hageman (R-WY) is one step closer to becoming Wyoming's next senator after handily winning Tuesday's Republican primary.

news-global-econ.title: Democrats pick their fighter for uphill bid to flip deep-red Senate seat
news-global-econ.description: James Byrd defeated Billy Benavidez in Wyoming's Democratic primary for the open Senate seat after Cynthia Lummis announced she won't seek reelection.
